5G Call Flow (UE-Initiated & UE-Terminated) - vCU / vDU / RF Module LIVE

A live model of the NG-RAN call flow animated end-to-end across every interface - Uu, Open Fronthaul (7.2x), F1-C, F1-U, E1, NG-C and NG-U - with the protocol shown on each hop. Choose UE-Initiated (Mobile Originated) or UE-Terminated (Mobile Terminated). The flow restarts after the final message so you can count the full sequence.

Illustrative UE-initiated setup for a virtualized, disaggregated gNB (higher-layer split at PDCP/RLC; Open Fronthaul intra-PHY 7.2x split). Interface routing and protocols follow 3GPP TS 38.401/38.300/38.473/37.483 and O-RAN.WG4 fronthaul; exact messages vary by deployment.
